title: Look up registration details for a domain name
summary: Use the whois command to find out who owns a website domain, when it was registered, and when it expires. This is useful for checking if a site is legitimate or finding contact info for spam.

steps.explain: Run the whois command followed by the domain name you want to investigate. It queries the global registry database and prints registration details.

placeholders.name: DOMAIN
placeholders.description: The domain name to look up, e.g. example.com

steps.expect: A long text output showing registrar, creation date, expiration date, and nameservers.
